verdict.rationale: Lambda documents a public, key-gated REST/Cloud API with a full OpenAPI 3.1 spec that could underlie SDK development, but no official first-party SDK client libraries (Python/JS/etc.) are evidenced — only an unofficial third-party CLI/MCP server exists. Missing for 10: official SDK packages/libraries, first-party language bindings, docs referencing an 'SDK' rather than raw REST endpoints.
